headline: Shanghai semifinals: Davidovich Fokina beats Zverev, Jodar beats Medvedev
whyCareReason: Both seeds lost. The final became an all-Spanish match.
teaser: Davidovich Fokina d. Zverev 5-7, 6-4, 6-3. Jodar d. Medvedev 6-3, 6-4.
story: Saturday 17 October at Qizhong did not follow the seeding. Alejandro Davidovich Fokina beat Alexander Zverev 5-7, 6-4, 6-3 in 2 hours 2 minutes, umpire Mohamed Lahyani. Rafael Jodar beat Daniil Medvedev 6-3, 6-4 in 1 hour 44 minutes, umpire Adel Nour. The earlier card that had Zverev beating Fokina and Medvedev beating Jodar is withdrawn.
stakes: The winners met in Sunday's final, which Davidovich Fokina won.
rivalryAngle: A 25th seed and a 20-year-old removed the year-end No. 1 and the 2019 champion.
funFacts: SF1: Alejandro Davidovich Fokina d. Alexander Zverev 5-7, 6-4, 6-3 in 2:02.
SF2: Rafael Jodar d. Daniil Medvedev 6-3, 6-4 in 1:44.
Zverev remains the year-end No. 1 after the loss.

keyPlayers.name: Alexander Zverev
keyPlayers.hook: Lost in three sets. Still the year-end No. 1.
